purpose: Executable ledger for the `computational-numerical-software` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Computational reproducibility rows make code, workflow, container, proof-assistant, benchmark, and analysis replay auditable. They can cap, freeze, or roll back computational support; they cannot promote a route by themselves.

reproducibility_rows.computational_artifact: FAMILYC-EW-CODE route proof, benchmark, simulation, solver, catalog, or analysis workflow artifact as applicable to the route target grain.
reproducibility_rows.execution_environment: declare source files, notebook/script entrypoint, container or environment lock, hardware-sensitive assumptions, and exact replay command before computational output can spend support
reproducibility_rows.dependency_lock: dependencies, compiler/interpreter versions, solver libraries, model weights, random seeds, and data-product versions must be frozen or declared nonportable
reproducibility_rows.seed_or_randomness_control: stochastic training, Monte Carlo, sampling, randomized simulation, event selection, or optimizer behavior must be seeded, replicated, or bounded by a variance audit
reproducibility_rows.replay_command: route-local replay must be possible from public carrier plus acquisition protocol, or the row is capped at custody/prose support only
reproducibility_rows.independent_reproduction_requirement: a different operator or environment must be able to reproduce the support-bearing result within declared tolerances before stronger computational language is allowed
